description.purpose: Portable W3C PROV-O lineage for existing BCM source documents, immutable artifacts, exact anchors, evidence links, and explicitly recorded processing activities or agents.
description.usage: Public BCM and private regulatory providers may exchange a validated PROV-O JSON-LD graph alongside the canonical EvidenceClaim/ProjectCodeBasis records; source policy and the canonical verifier alone decide legal status.
description.limitations: Metadata and deterministic lineage only; a well-formed graph does not establish authentic source bytes, independent review, legally effective adoption, address-level jurisdiction or a verified project. No private source text or bulk regulatory corpus may be published.

properties.name: @context
properties.description: Fixed W3C PROV-O, BCM extension and XML Schema namespace bindings

properties.name: @graph
properties.description: At least one graph node; source-only entities, genuinely observed activities and agents

properties.name: @graph[].@id
properties.description: Absolute, stable URI for each graph node

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:sourceID
properties.description: Preserved BCM source identity, never constructed from a URL alone

properties.name: @graph[].bcm:sha256
properties.description: 64-character exact immutable source or passage digest
